function.name: tiff_error_handler
function.description: This function handles errors for TIFF files. If an error is detected, it logs the error message and outputs a newline character.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: The name of the module where the error occurred.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the error message to be logged.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: A list of arguments to be included in the error message.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: tiff_warning_handler
function.description: This function handles warnings for TIFF files. If warnings are enabled, it logs the warning message and outputs a newline character.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: The name of the module where the warning occurred.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the warning message.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: A list of arguments to be used in the warning message.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: tiff_stream_read
function.description: This function reads data from a stream into a buffer

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: Handle to the client data

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Buffer to store the read data

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of bytes to read from the stream

function.return_type: tsize_t, represents the number of bytes actually read from the stream

function.name: tiff_stream_write
function.description: This function writes data to a stream. It returns the number of bytes written. If the write operation fails, it returns 0.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: Handle to the client data, which is cast to a stream

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data to be written to the stream

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the data to be written

function.return_type: tsize_t, represents the number of bytes written to the stream

function.name: tiff_stream_seek
function.description: This function seeks to a specific position in a TIFF stream.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: This is a handle to the client data.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: This is the offset from the origin.

parameters.name: whence
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the origin from where to start seeking.

function.return_type: toff_t, represents the new position in the stream after seeking. If the operation fails, it returns -1.

function.name: tiff_stream_close
function.description: This function is used to close a TIFF stream. The caller is responsible for releasing the stream object.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: This parameter is used to handle the TIFF stream.

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns 0 indicating successful execution.

function.name: tiff_stream_size
function.description: This function retrieves the size of a TIFF stream.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to the TIFF stream.

function.return_type: toff_t, represents the size of the TIFF stream. Returns -1 if the operation is unsuccessful.

function.name: tiff_stream_map
function.description: This function is used to map a stream but it cannot mmap streams, so it always returns 0.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: Handle to the client data

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Address to map the stream to

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the stream to map

function.return_type: int, always returns 0 because it cannot mmap streams

function.name: tiff_stream_unmap
function.description: This function doesn't perform any operation, as it can't map things.

parameters.name: client_data
parameters.description: Client data handle

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Address to unmap

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the data to unmap

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: tiff_open_stream
function.description: This function opens a TIFF stream with a specified mode, using the provided IStream object.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The IStream object to be used for opening the TIFF stream.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode in which the TIFF stream is to be opened.

function.return_type: TIFF*, represents the opened TIFF stream.

function.name: impl_from_decoder
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the tiff_decoder structure that contains the given decoder structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to the decoder structure.

function.return_type: struct tiff_decoder*, a pointer to the tiff_decoder structure that contains the given decoder structure.

function.name: tiff_get_decode_info
function.description: This function retrieves decoding information from a TIFF image file and stores it in a tiff_decode_info structure.

parameters.name: tiff
parameters.description: A pointer to the TIFF image file from which to retrieve decoding information.

parameters.name: decode_info
parameters.description: A pointer to a tiff_decode_info structure in which to store the retrieved decoding information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK indicates success, while other values indicate various types of failure.

function.name: tiff_decoder_should_skip_directory
function.description: This function checks if a directory in a TIFF file should be skipped based on its subfile type.

parameters.name: tiff
parameters.description: A pointer to the TIFF file being checked.

function.return_type: bool, returns true if the directory should be skipped, false otherwise.

function.name: tiff_decoder_collect_frames
function.description: This function collects frames from a TIFF decoder. It counts the number of directories in the TIFF file, allocates memory for a map of frames, and iterates over each directory. If a directory should be skipped, it continues to the next one. If not, it adds the directory to the frame map. If no frames are found, it frees the memory and returns an error. If frames are found, it sets the first useful directory and assigns the frame count and map to the decoder.

parameters.name: decoder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the TIFF decoder from which frames are to be collected.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, E_FAIL if setting a directory fails, and WINCODEC_ERR_BADIMAGE if no frames are found.

function.name: tiff_decoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a TIFF decoder. It opens a TIFF stream, collects frames, gets decode info, and sets the frame count and flags in the decoder_stat structure. If any operation fails, it closes the TIFF stream and returns the error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder structure

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream to be decoded

parameters.name: st
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder_stat structure where the function sets the frame count and flags

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise it returns the error code.

function.name: tiff_decoder_select_frame
function.description: This function selects a specific frame in a TIFF file for decoding. If the frame is already cached, it returns immediately. Otherwise, it sets the directory to the desired frame, gets the decode info, and updates the cached frame and tile.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the TIFF decoder structure which contains information about the TIFF file and the current decoding state.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: The frame number to select for decoding.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the frame number is invalid or if there is a failure in setting the directory, or other error codes indicating specific failures in the decoding process.

function.name: tiff_decoder_get_frame_info
function.description: This function selects a frame in a TIFF decoder and if successful, assigns the frame information to the provided info parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface to the decoder structure.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: The frame number to be selected in the decoder.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a decoder_frame structure where the frame information will be stored if the frame selection is successful.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the frame selection operation. If successful, the frame information is stored in the 'info' parameter.

function.name: tiff_decoder_get_decoder_palette
function.description: This function is used to get the decoder palette of a TIFF image.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder interface

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: The frame number

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: Pointer to the color palette

parameters.name: num_colors
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of colors

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE indicating that the palette is unavailable.

function.name: tiff_read_tile
function.description: This function reads a tile from a TIFF image, either from a tiled image or a stripped image. It calculates the index of the tile or strip to read, reads it into the provided buffer, and sets the output length to the number of bytes read.

parameters.name: decoder
parameters.description: Pointer to the TIFF decoder structure

parameters.name: tile_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the tile to read

parameters.name: tile_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the tile to read

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The sample number to read

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the read data will be stored

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the buffer

parameters.name: out_length
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the number of bytes read

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK on success and E_FAIL if the read operation fails

function.name: tiff_decoder_copy_planes
function.description: This function is used to copy the planes of a TIFF decoder. It calculates the sample size and width in bytes, then loops through each tile in the height and width, copying the data from the source to the destination. It supports different bits per sample sizes.

parameters.name: decoder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the TIFF decoder structure which contains the information about the TIFF image being decoded.

parameters.name: srcdata
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the source data that is to be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, and E_NOTIMPL if the bits per sample is not a multiple of 8.

function.name: tiff_decoder_read_tile
function.description: This function reads a tile from a TIFF image, decodes it and stores it in a cache. It handles different color depths and configurations, including planar and contiguous, and different color formats, including RGB and RGBA. It also handles grayscale images and can invert them if needed.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the tiff_decoder structure which contains information about the TIFF image and the current decoding state.

parameters.name: tile_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the tile to be read.

parameters.name: tile_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the tile to be read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK is returned on success, and an error code is returned on failure.

function.name: tiff_decoder_copy_pixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a TIFF image frame to a buffer, taking into account the image's tile structure. It also handles memory allocation for the tile cache and error checking for the frame selection and pixel copying processes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder structure

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: The frame number to be decoded

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICRect structure that specifies the portion of the image to copy

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the bitmap. This is the number of bytes from one row of pixels in memory to the next row of pixels in memory

parameters.name: buffersize
parameters.description: The size of the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the pixels will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code

function.name: tiff_decoder_get_color_context
function.description: This function selects a frame in a TIFF image, retrieves its color profile, and copies it into a dynamically allocated buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder interface

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: The frame to select in the TIFF image

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Unused parameter in the function

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the color profile data will be copied

parameters.name: datasize
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the size of the color profile data will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_UNEXPECTED if the TIFF image does not have a color profile, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: tiff_decoder_get_metadata_blocks
function.description: This function selects a frame from a TIFF decoder, sets the count to 1, and assigns metadata to a decoder block. It then allocates memory for the block and assigns the result to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the decoder

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame to be selected from the TIFF decoder

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to hold the count of metadata blocks

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: Pointer to hold the allocated memory for the decoder block

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. If the function fails to select the frame, it returns the error code. If it succeeds, it returns S_OK.

function.name: tiff_decoder_destroy
function.description: This function is used to free up the memory allocated to the TIFF decoder. It closes the TIFF file if it's open, and then frees the memory allocated to the cached tile, frame map, and the decoder itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the decoder structure that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: tiff_decoder_create
function.description: This function creates a TIFF decoder, sets the decoder's vtable to the tiff_decoder_vtable, sets the cached tile x to -1, and assigns the address of the decoder to the result. It also sets the container format, block format, and clsid of the info structure. Finally, it sets the error and warning handlers for the TIFF.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a decoder_info structure. This structure is used to set the container format, block format, and clsid.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a decoder structure. The address of the decoder is assigned to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully. If memory allocation for the TIFF decoder fails, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: impl_from_encoder
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the tiff_encoder structure that contains the given encoder structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an encoder structure.

function.return_type: struct tiff_encoder*, represents a pointer to the tiff_encoder structure that contains the given encoder structure.

function.name: tiff_encoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a TIFF encoder with a given stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the interface of the encoder.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This parameter is used to provide the stream to which the TIFF encoder will write.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise it returns E_FAIL.

function.name: tiff_encoder_get_supported_format
function.description: This function checks the compatibility of the provided pixel format with the supported formats. If the format is not supported, it defaults to the first format in the list. It then updates the pixel format, bits per pixel (bpp), and indexed status according to the matched or default format.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder interface

parameters.name: pixel_format
parameters.description: Pointer to the GUID representing the pixel format to be checked

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: Pointer to the DWORD representing the bits per pixel of the format

parameters.name: indexed
parameters.description: Pointer to the BOOL indicating whether the format is indexed or not

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: tiff_encoder_create_frame
function.description: This function creates a frame for a TIFF encoder. It sets various fields for the TIFF file such as photometric interpretation, planar configuration, bits per sample, samples per pixel, image width and height, resolution, and color map if applicable.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the encoder interface used for the TIFF encoder.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: This is the frame to be encoded into the TIFF file.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. Returns S_OK if the function executes successfully.

function.name: tiff_encoder_write_lines
function.description: This function writes lines to a TIFF encoder. It also handles the case where the format requires reversing BGR and the bits per sample is 8.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the encoder

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Data to be written

parameters.name: line_count
parameters.description: Number of lines to be written

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Stride of the data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails

function.name: tiff_encoder_commit_frame
function.description: This function commits a frame to a TIFF encoder

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the encoder structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK indicates success

function.name: tiff_encoder_commit_file
function.description: This function commits a TIFF file by closing it and setting its reference to NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: tiff_encoder_destroy
function.description: This function closes the TIFF file associated with the given encoder and frees the memory allocated for the encoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure that is associated with the TIFF file to be closed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: tiff_encoder_create
function.description: This function creates a TIFF encoder, sets its properties, and assigns it to the result pointer. It also sets the error and warning handlers for the TIFF encoder.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to an encoder_info structure where the function sets the encoder's properties.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an encoder structure where the function assigns the created TIFF encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and S_OK if the function executes successfully.
